page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head centred above the text; catchword "pugnæ" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: ris medullam se spargente contagio, ut uicta iam humana medicina, solum in supremi medici misericordia sita esse res uideatur. Nam si nihil accederet præter bellicas has furias, quæ tanta humani generis pernicie, monarchas monarchis, regna regnis, cœlum denique terrę cōmiscent (ut nihil fere usquam tutum sit mortalibus) quantum uel hic calamitatis pelagus: Nūc eo ies redit, ut hic mi-nima humanæ infœlicitatis sit portio. Quippe externi bellorū tumultus, etsi pacem eripiunt, habent tamen leges suas qualescunqʒ, habent & inducias: certè hyems quamlibet hostiles pugnas dirimit, nec ultra corpora sęuiunt, quin nec uniuersos inuoluunt exitio, nonnunquam & hostis hostem compellat amicè, misfitiis etiam xeniolis ultro citroq; acceptis. Deinde utcunq; cadat Martis anceps alea, multis uel parcit misericordia, uel redimit pecunia. At hæc animorum diffidia, ac factionū pugnæ

page.notes: Printed text is set in a single column with a few worn letters; "fitiis" and "hostis hostem" as printed, possibly misprints. Uncertain readings: "fitiis" [?]. The word "pugnæ" at the foot is the catchword.
